description: Convert a JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or supported static SVG to JPEG, PNG or WebP (format, quality, lossless). Vectorize a PNG or JPEG to black SVG paths on a transparent background (threshold). The trace fits within 1024 by 1024 pixels. For JPEG, PNG or WebP, compress (quality), resize (width, height, fit contain or cover, upscale, format), read metadata including any GPS position (metadata), strip EXIF, XMP and IPTC (strip), find its main colors (colors, count) or make favicons as a ZIP (favicon, crop fit, trim or center, name). Resize also accepts HEIC. Metadata and strip also accept GIF. Give image_base64 or storage_id, for example the result of an earlier call. Every result is stored for 24 hours and the answer carries its storage_id, so calls can be chained. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.

image_base64.description: The file as standard base64, at most about 190 KB of file through MCP. For a larger file, store it with REST POST /services/v1/storage first and pass storage_id.

name.description: favicon only: the site name for the manifest.

storage_id.description: A storage_id from store_file, from a previous tool result, or from REST /storage. Objects expire 24 hours after they were stored.

threshold.description: Brightness threshold in percent for vectorize. Higher values include lighter pixels.

name: process_image
title: Convert, vectorize, resize or inspect an image
